glossary.definition: (A) "Fruit or vegetable" means any fresh unprocessed fruit or vegetable which is intended for human consumption.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 925.22 to 925.32 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 925.21 - Containers for fresh fruits and vegetables definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Container" means any device used to hold or enclose a quantity of fruits or vegetables, except one with a capacity of one dry quart or less which is packed in a larger container marked in compliance with sections 925.21 to 925.32 , inclusive, of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 925.22 to 925.32 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 925.21 - Containers for fresh fruits and vegetables definitions.

glossary.definition:
(C) "Person" includes any individual, company, partnership, corporation, or association or any combination of individuals of whatever form and character, also any employee, agent, or officer thereof.
